body_markdown:
***Financing supports Kisco Senior Living’s Drake Terrace community in San Rafael***


**NEW YORK, Nov. 16, 2026** – Lument announced today the closing of a $52.2 million Freddie Mac loan to refinance Drake Terrace, a 123-unit senior living community in San Rafael, California. The transaction was led by Chris Cain, Tyler Armstrong, and Taylor Russ, managing directors with Lument’s seniors housing and healthcare team.


The Freddie Mac loan features a 10-year fixed-rate term with full-term interest-only payments. The loan refinances existing Freddie Mac debt and provides cash-out proceeds.


Drake Terrace is owned and operated by Kisco Senior Living, which acquired the property in 2001. The community was originally developed in 1989 and offers independent and assisted living, in addition to memory care. Located approximately 22 miles north of San Francisco, Drake Terrace has maintained occupancy above 91% throughout the past 24 months.


“Drake Terrace’s strong and consistent operating performance, combined with Kisco’s extensive experience in senior housing, made this an excellent fit for Freddie Mac financing,” said Cain. “We were pleased to once again work with Kisco and Freddie Mac to structure a long-term financing solution that provides stability and flexibility for the community.”


“The Lument team’s deep Freddie Mac expertise was instrumental in navigating the financing process and bringing this transaction to a successful close,” said Cullen Bautch, director of acquisitions and investments at Kisco Senior Living. “Lument has been a trusted collaborator, consistently helping us advance our strategic objectives through thoughtful financial solutions tailored to our portfolio and long-term goals.”


The transaction represents another Freddie Mac closing completed by Lument on behalf of Kisco. Cain and Lument previously worked with the company on the financing of Park Terrace, which closed in May 2025. Kisco is an experienced Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae borrower with a portfolio of senior living communities across the United States.


**About Lument**


Lument delivers a comprehensive set of capital solutions customized for investors in multifamily, affordable housing, and seniors housing real estate, as well as healthcare and other commercial asset classes. Lument’s experienced professionals leverage deep relationships and market knowledge to help clients achieve their financial objectives.
